$comment: ADM-002 (#455) / ADR-0019. The pinned inputs a GoGo administrative dataset is built from. The importer verifies every sha256 here against the decompressed bytes before parsing anything, and refuses to run on a mismatch — a snapshot that has drifted is not the snapshot the counts and the licence review were done against.

sources.authority: Tổng cục Thống kê (General Statistics Office of Vietnam)
sources.note: The only source that decides whether a current target code exists.
The last three-level snapshot. Imported INACTIVE and effective-dated; the only source of LEGACY_DISTRICT units.
ADVISORY ONLY. Never authoritative current data. A row is promoted to a canonical change solely when both endpoints resolve against the two sources above; nothing here may mint a current unit.

knownDefects.issue: lowercase unit-type prefix; every other row capitalises it
knownDefects.handling: unit type is derived case-insensitively and a warning is raised — the source is not silently corrected

knownDefects.issue: five rows carry a district-level source rather than a commune (island districts that became đặc khu: Bạch Long Vĩ, Cồn Cỏ, Hoàng Sa, Lý Sơn, Côn Đảo; Cồn Cỏ 45→44 and Côn Đảo 77→79 also change province)
knownDefects.handling: classified VALID_DISTRICT_TO_SPECIAL_ZONE — they are correct data in an unexpected shape, not malformed rows
